ContainerWidth.helper: Layout. Controls the maximum width of the inner content container.

MarginTop.title: Margin (top)
MarginTop.helper: Spacing. Optional utility class controlling spacing above this section.

MarginBottom.title: Margin (bottom)
MarginBottom.helper: Spacing. Optional utility class controlling spacing below this section.

PaddingTop.title: Padding (top)
PaddingTop.helper: Spacing. Optional utility class controlling inner spacing above the content.

PaddingBottom.title: Padding (bottom)
PaddingBottom.helper: Spacing. Optional utility class controlling inner spacing below the content.

BackgroundColorClass.helper: Background. Choose a light shared Bootstrap/site background utility.

AccentColor.helper: Design. Hex color used for the left accent border on form inputs. Use #RGB or #RRGGBB only. Defaults to #ff4057.

FormAction.helper: Behavior. Submission target for the form. Allowed values are relative URLs, anchors, http, or https. Leave blank to use the default handler.

FormMethod.helper: Behavior. HTTP method used when the configured action receives the form.

NameRequired.helper: Required fields. When enabled, both first and last name inputs render with required attributes and a red asterisk.

EmailRequired.helper: Required fields. When enabled, the email input renders with a required attribute and a red asterisk.

RequestRequired.helper: Required fields. When enabled, the request textarea renders with a required attribute and a red asterisk.

EnableRecaptcha.helper: reCAPTCHA. When enabled, renders a Google reCAPTCHA v2 checkbox before the submit button. The configured form handler must validate the response server-side.

RecaptchaSiteKey.helper: reCAPTCHA. Public Google reCAPTCHA site key. Do not enter the secret key here.

RecaptchaTheme.helper: reCAPTCHA. Visual theme for the reCAPTCHA checkbox.

RecaptchaSize.helper: reCAPTCHA. Size for the reCAPTCHA checkbox.
